rows.Notes: First fish, right off Maxwelton, 9:30am with the pink spinner
Long day, including time with Mark and Eli. Fished all over Maxwelton, Possession, Point no Point, 2 fish were just north of Hansville, Foulweather Bluff. Got gas too
Possession point, great sunny day during vacation. Carol went back to church for the day
Limited! All of them right off Maxwelton
Caught after dad went to bed. Used for Salmon burgers with R&H
With dad
3 hours in the morning at Useless Bay (3 fish), beautiful sunrise. Then 3 hours again with Josh at sunset (2 more, plus one he caught).
Not wanting to go home, and super long ferry lines anyway…
Fishing with Carol, plus one hour on my own beforehand
Work day, an hour on the water with Carol, dropped her off at the beach, then one more hour, then Sebo's, then Mick & Petina, then more fishing
8-4, including time with Josh and Isaiah. 1 hard one pink, but a big one
3 hours with Theo, then 3 hours in the evening
3 hours in the morning, 2 hours in the evening, with a Sandy Point visit in between
Testing trolling setup
1 pink right away, and some Coho battles at Posession, but lost them
COHO!! 6! Two were wild, three got away at the boat (one MONSTER) and one keeper
Quick evening trip before day off. Beautiful evening, but no fish
Two Coho while fishing with Josh, and then Emma and Carol came out. Emma caught a giant one, but it was wild.
Quick lunch trip at Double Bluff. No fish, but that shelf looks promising.
SO much fun with Brad, Miles, and Emma. 12 fish, 3 wilds, 2 keepers, 7 losses, a couple right at the boat. I dropped Emma's giant 8 pounder *@!!!
Pretty much skunked. No herring strips left. A few big fish on the line, but only landed one 2 pound coho.
HUGE 8 pound COHO. What a fight! So much fun. 5 shakers, and one 5 pound wild. The silver and red flasher seemed to work better than the yellow one.
Tried the Shipwreck area for the first time, it was packed. Turns out it was the last day for that area. 2 wilds made it complicated.
With Brad and Miles. They took 4 home, I had a big one on, but lost it.
Early morning session. SO fun. One Chinook, one giant Coho.
Apple cove with Dad. At least a dozen shakers, and one good medium Coho
Skunked! Moonlight trip solo, not even one bite. Later with dad, lots more shakers. Dropped dad off in Edmonds
With Brent at Desert Aire. Tons of fun, learned a lot about river guide fishing in the Columbia
Had to hand off a 20 pound fish to Tom, so I'm counting it :-)
Beautiful sunny day. No luck at Oil docks or over at Apple Cove
With Josh. Pretty spicy out there, and a bunch of Trawlers still. Two Jack's, and one big hit, but no keepers.
With Emma - final day of the season. Big winds and whitecaps on a calming day, but borderline sketchy. Emma caught a Chum
